lenses.name: error-path forcing
lenses.reason: Externally closed pinned tabs were driven through real CLI, batch, and E2E paths.

lenses.name: new failure outcome propagation
lenses.reason: Both response construction paths and downstream adapters were traced.

lenses.name: docs-behavior parity
lenses.reason: All required public surfaces were aligned with observed output.

lenses.name: boundary pipeline trace
lenses.reason: Daemon response, client response, batch result, and MCP wrapper were verified.

lenses.name: substrate verification
lenses.reason: The built binary was driven against real Chrome.

lenses.name: test strength
lenses.reason: Removing enrichment made the intended CLI and E2E assertions fail.

lenses.name: security and privacy
lenses.reason: Safe and opaque URL classes were exercised.

lenses.name: complexity budget
lenses.reason: No loop, lookup, or per-element path changed.

lenses.name: timing dominance
lenses.reason: No timeout or timing constant changed.

lenses.name: persistent artifact lifecycle
lenses.reason: No new persistent artifact was introduced.

lenses.name: concurrency
lenses.reason: No scheduling or ownership behavior changed.

deterministic.reason: Untouched mentions describe unchanged semantics or terse listings; canonical contract passages were updated.
SCIP duplicate-symbol errors yielded 0 changed symbols and 2384 unresolved calls, so the map was treated as under-covering.

findings.claim: The structured recovery data may fail to reach batch or MCP.
findings.evidence: Real CLI batch output exposes result.targetId and result.lastUrl; MCP unit output exposes structuredContent.response.data.
findings.path: BrowserManager -> execute_command -> Response.data -> batch result / MCP response

findings.claim: Structured output may leak opaque URL payloads.
findings.evidence: The data URL E2E exposes targetId and omits lastUrl; both bound-gone writers call sanitize_url.

findings.claim: The full action parity test times out on screenshot.
findings.evidence: It fails identically on the patch and exact base commit 21667e9.

exemptions.claim: The screenshot parity timeout does not block this response-contract patch.
exemptions.evidence: The exact base commit fails on the same action with the same timeout.

exemptions.claim: Untouched tab_gone mentions do not all require edits.
exemptions.evidence: They describe unchanged state semantics, sanitization, batch code propagation, or terse option listings.

issue_candidates.title: Stabilize the documented-actions screenshot parity test
issue_candidates.evidence: The 10-second screenshot action timeout reproduces on base 21667e9 and the patch.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The patch only enriches an existing error response and does not touch screenshot or action iteration.
